data.name: NodeBuilder.Readme
data.value:
# {0} {1}
Target: {2}, {3}.
Services: {4}.
Migrations: {5}.
1. Define cross-node order, remote readiness and downtime with the delivery owner. 2. Verify the installation archive and run `containerizer prepare {6}.tar.gz --name {0}`. 3. Stop affected application nodes with `containerizer stop --name {0}`. 4. Install/upgrade with `--no-start` in the agreed migration order. 5. After all migrations succeed, run `containerizer start --name {0}` on each node.
Recovery never automatically reruns an interrupted migration. Ordinary uninstall retains data; `--purge` removes owned local data and state.
